verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Fivetran serves an llms.txt at fivetran.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a documentation index. Many docs pages are also published as raw .md URLs that agents can ingest directly. Fivetran adds agent-oriented guidance through AI coding-agent plugins that bring Connector SDK skills to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Copilot CLI. Missing for 10: the /docs.md root returns 404, there is no evidence of how deep or complete the llms.txt content is (no llms-full.txt), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.
